items.name: Fall of Nineveh
items.why: Babylonians and Medes sack the Assyrian capital: the event that effectively ended the Neo-Assyrian Empire (just drafted, which currently has no ending event).

items.name: Egyptian–Hittite Peace Treaty
items.why: Ramesses II and Hattusili III make peace after Kadesh: one of the earliest peace treaties whose text survives, in both Egyptian and Akkadian versions. Would follow Battle of Kadesh.

items.name: Polynesian Settlement of the Pacific
items.why: A frame for the Lapita, Hawaii, Rapa Nui and New Zealand items just drafted, so they could be part_of one story instead of loose events.
